name: Broadcom
description: Broadcom has two businesses. Semiconductor solutions sells chips for data-center networking and AI (custom AI accelerators called XPUs, Ethernet switching and routing chips, NICs, optical parts, and racks built on its XPUs), plus wireless, broadband, storage and industrial chips. Infrastructure software (VMware products plus mainframe, security and network software) sells subscriptions and support to large enterprises. The software line earned an operating margin of 77% in FY2025 and 84% in Q3 FY2026. Semiconductors rose from 58% of revenue in FY2025 to 70% in Q3 FY2026 as AI demand grew.

That page gives only sector and sub-industry; industry group and industry are null because no source read states them. Labelled conventional filing only; Mowgli classification is not assigned here.

businessLines.name: Semiconductor solutions
businessLines.how: Chips sold per unit mostly through distributors and to a few large customers; custom AI accelerators are made to order under long-term contracts (remaining performance obligations $179.2B across contracts at 2026-08-02, about 25% expected as revenue within 12 months).
businessLines.description: AI data-center chips and systems (custom accelerators, Ethernet switching and routing, NICs, PHYs, optical components, racks), plus wireless, broadband, server storage connectivity and industrial chips.

businessLines.name: Infrastructure software
businessLines.how: Multi-year enterprise software subscriptions and support, renewed on contract terms.
businessLines.description: VMware Cloud Foundation, vSphere Foundation, edge, Telco Cloud Platform, plus mainframe, security and network software.

brands.name: VMware (Cloud Foundation, vSphere Foundation)
brands.share: Infrastructure software was 42% of FY2025 revenue and 30% of Q3 FY2026 revenue; VMware product-level revenue not broken out

brands.name: Custom AI accelerators (XPUs), Ethernet switching, NICs
